summary: Five prior findings are addressed. Structured failure evidence still misidentifies adapter failures; correct this before freezing and starting.

findings.issue: The adapter's actual reload-parity exception, "Saved candidate does not reproduce in-memory scores." (model_adapter.py:295), becomes INVALID_SCORES rather than RELOAD_PARITY. An in-memory worker check confirmed this. Invalid score vectors produce identical operation/stage/error-type/reason fields. Likewise, incomplete optimization and unchanged encoder weights share one exception and reason code. Because raw diagnostics are deliberately omitted, the terminal audit cannot distinguish these failed invariants.
findings.requiredFix: Give adapter invariant failures explicit, text-free reason codes and propagate them unchanged through worker failure, JobFailure, terminal state and reporting. Add regression checks using the actual mocked adapter failure paths for reload parity, invalid scores, incomplete steps and unchanged weights.
